statement: Video shows optimal route to complete World 1 party dungeons using a grumbler build and an rng voucher build; the two builds differ.
Rig your inventory so all dungeon materials sit right beside each other for easy shift-click dropping.
Shift-click drops an item instantly with no drag and drop needed.
RNG voucher card order: rng item, rarity, block chance, dungeon MP regen, base damage, base MP; starting with 60 rng item, 12 dungeon money, 6 dungeon boss damage.
Card stats will change depending on what star level your cards have.
Running stardew drop with maestro makes MP regen and base MP cards very strong.
RNG voucher traits: middle one for base damage, left side for two gray rng items to start.
Each gray rng item gives plus one percent drop chance at rank 15.
Rank 25 trait: enhancers instead of mobs.
Rank 30 trait: shop prices from rng items are scaled lower.
Rank 35 trait: higher rarity rng item (green or better) 25 percent more likely.
Grumble build traits mostly the same, but take armor and jewelry drop instead of weapons.
Grumble build also takes shop prices for rng slower and +1 choice on rng items from non-shop sources, which can give an extra gray choice.
World 1 party dungeons are about drop chance unlike World 2 and World 3.
You want lots of drop chance so enemies drop materials that let you keep summoning the boss.
With the grey grumble build prioritize getting a couple of rabbit's paws to help drop rate.
If running rng voucher, liar's craps is your best tool for ensuring drops.
Liar's craps gives less max HP but 20 percent drop rate at highest level.
Use liar's craps to help ensure you summon third frog because getting an eye to drop is abysmal.
Grey grumble build priority items: sugar rush, sharp eye, rabbit's paw, boss skull, grey grumble, stardew drop, handy ice pick; rest are commodity.
RNG voucher build priority items: sugar rush, sharp eye, stardew drop, handy ice pick, boss skull, rng voucher, dead book, single cut, liar's craps, sucker punch.
Those items are your main tools for damage and getting high crits.
All builds are built around getting horn of the fool; take it as soon as you have enough crit.
Grumbler build start: clear the first two huts on the left side and move up; the other huts are handled later.
Destroy the whole middle row of huts until your big AOEs come off cooldown.
Then slap on auto and let the character attack while you go to the shop and buy rng items.
Sell all enhancers found on the ground in the grumbler build because you are not using them yet.
Move up top and destroy the two huts for a nice AOE cleave while still selling enhancers.
Whenever buying from the shop put it on auto.
Leave the right side hut because it loses a ton of time; come back for it later only if necessary.
At boss rush phase, shift-click and drop all your items; you should be about three frog legs short.
While dropping items kill the remaining huts and drop the last frog legs to warn the boss.
Constantly pick up items during boss phase because resources consumed will not count toward the next phase.
Continue killing mobs and collecting materials and only drop the ones needed to spawn the next frog.
Nuke the frog while spending money on rng items; buy two accessories and four armor pieces, plus a couple weapons if not maestro.
Stop picking up monster materials during third phase since it is the last phase so monsters spawn as much as possible.
With enough drop chance you can spawn third frog without needing the upper right hut and save about a minute.
Still pick up monster materials if they are not right beside the cauldron so they get consumed.
Once third frog is spawned get into a position where you won't get hit and only hit the boss.
Spend weapon, accessory and armor enhancers: crit chance or total damage percent for weapons.
Use boss damage on every armor piece and total damage percent on accessories.
At this point rng items cost around 1.3 to 1.7k so they are too expensive; enhancers give the extra damage.
You skipped enhancers earlier because you swap armor all run so money from selling enhancers mattered more then.
Roguelike, not guaranteed, but grumble build is a consistent approach; repeat the same strat with trial and error and you will get third frog kill.
RNG voucher build begins the same: clear right side huts, then middle with auto on while buying rng items.
In rng voucher build, do not sell any enhancers; leave them on the ground until later.
After clearing top, if you have no rng voucher yet sell the top enhancers since you won't return and they are out of camera.
Same as before: drop items, pick up remaining frog legs, and follow the same steps all the way to third frog.
If you still haven't got the rng voucher, leave the enhancers on the ground; you will eventually get it.
You should have at least one rng voucher by third frog.
Stand where you won't get hit, don't use auto because it changes target priority by distance, and focus the boss.
Buy a couple pieces of armor, weapons and accessories if you haven't already.
Spam around 10 to 15 enhancers and sell them while you have a decent reservoir of money.
Buy the cheapest rng items and keep going until prices scale past what you can afford.
